newsitem.title: USA: NYSE says Applied Magnetics won't comment.
newsitem.headline: NYSE says Applied Magnetics won't comment.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said Thursday that Applied Magnetics Corp would not comment on the unusual market activity in the company's stock.
Applied Magnetic closed down about 7-1/4 to 38 in heavy trading.
The exchange said it contacted the company seeking a public statement indicating whether there were any corporate developments to explain the activity.
The exchange said it was told by the company that it was not its policy to comment on unusual market activity or rumors.
Earlier this week, Applied Magnetics issued a hostile takeover bid for Read-Rite Corp at about $36 a share. The total value of the deal is about $1.76 billion.
